_meta.purpose: Seed catalog of kitesurf spots with nearest airports and wind season. Powers the wind+flight intersection in flightscope.
_meta.season_codes: Months are 1-12. wind_months = the reliably-kiteable window.
_meta.windguru_id: Numeric windguru.cz spot id, coordinate-verified to the real kite spot. Powers live forecast wind ranking. Find new ids via the search_spots endpoint (see cli-connections/windguru).

spots.name: Tarifa
spots.note: Home base. Levante (E) is strong/gusty, Poniente (W) is cleaner. No airport in Tarifa itself.

spots.name: Fuerteventura (Sotavento)
spots.note: Trade winds, huge lagoon at low tide. Best May-Sep.

spots.name: Lanzarote (Costa Teguise)
spots.note: Year-round-ish trades, strongest summer.

spots.name: Gran Canaria (Pozo Izquierdo)
spots.note: Very strong summer trades, advanced/expert.

spots.name: Leucate / La Franqui
spots.note: Tramontane wind, best shoulder seasons.

spots.name: Sardinia (Porto Pollo)
spots.note: Mistral funnels through the strait; reliable thermals.

spots.name: Sicily (Lo Stagnone, Marsala)
spots.note: Flat shallow lagoon, beginner-friendly, thermals.

spots.name: Rhodes (Prasonisi)
spots.note: Meltemi (N) wind, very consistent in summer.

spots.name: Naxos / Paros
spots.note: Meltemi summer wind. Often via Santorini (JTR) or Athens.

spots.name: Lefkada (Vasiliki)
spots.note: Afternoon thermal 'Eric' wind, learner-friendly bay.

spots.name: Dakhla
spots.note: Flat lagoon, near year-round wind. Best Apr-Sep.

spots.name: Essaouira
spots.note: Strong Alizé trade wind in summer.

spots.name: Aurora Reservoir
spots.note: Local Denver-area reservoir. Verify park rules, launch access, storms, and water level before kiting.

spots.name: Cherry Creek Reservoir
spots.note: Local Denver-area reservoir. Gusty inland wind; verify launch access, storms, and local restrictions before kiting.

spots.name: Chatfield Reservoir
spots.note: Used the coordinate-verified Windguru id; earlier Chatfield hits report bad longitude. Verify launch rules and gust/storm risk.

spots.name: Union Reservoir
spots.note: Longmont-area local option. Verify city rules, watercraft policy, and launch conditions before kiting.

spots.name: Boyd Lake
spots.note: Loveland-area lake. Check state park rules, storm risk, and gust spread before kiting.

spots.name: Lake Dillon
spots.note: Mountain reservoir with cold water and gusty terrain effects. Treat forecast as a first screen, not a go/no-go by itself.

spots.name: Pueblo Reservoir
spots.note: Southern Colorado reservoir. Verify state park rules, shoreline access, and storm timing before kiting.

spots.name: Lake McConaughy
spots.note: Driveable high-plains lake from Colorado. Often a better wind target than Front Range reservoirs, but check distance, storms, and beach access.

spots.name: Sal
spots.note: WINTER season spot. Good when Europe is cold.
